description: Self-reference control. The seller may have real technical friction signals, but must never be qualified as an external sales opportunity for its own services.

required_reasoning_properties: self-reference overrides any positive technical signal
technical scan evidence is triage evidence, not purchase intent
private/internal knowledge must not be used as prospect evidence

notes.economic_reason: Early exit avoids unnecessary contact discovery, offer mapping, drafting, and model/search spend on an impossible prospect.
notes.regression_reason: A future change that turns this company into qualified_for_review is a hard policy regression even if the scan finds genuine friction.
